items.title: Define localReady and unify readiness blocking semantics
items.context: Add an explicit StoryReadinessReport contract: localReady is true iff there are no readiness rows with blocking:true. Advisory/warn rows must remain visible but must not block target readiness. Manual and external rows must be represented as non-command next actions when no command is available.
items.userSees: StoryReadinessCheck 可见 localReady 定义与 blocking 判定已统一；manual/external 行在报告中作为 next action 给出，非阻塞但不丢失。

happy.desc: 文档明确 localReady=无 blocking:true 行

edge.desc: 检查 advisory/warn 与 manual/external 在准备态展示时不阻塞 target readiness

adversarial.desc: 验证未将 rollback 渲染为 STOP 后续阶段，而是作为可选 next action

verificationEvidence.note: In canonical report schema, added explicit localReady computation rule and documented non-blocking advisory behavior.
LocalReady semantics documented and enforced as no blocking rows in readiness report.
Manual proof checks show advisory/warn rows remain visible and do not block localReady.
Rollback remains a likely next action, not a hard lifecycle stage, in V1 read-only check model.

items.title: Bind done_prepare report freshness to current local main tip
items.context: Extend done_prepare binding semantics so a consumed report records the local main tip or merge base observed during preparation and is stale when current local main has advanced. This prevents V1 from marking DONE-ready when a new main merge would invalidate the report.
items.userSees: 当 main 主分支前移后，lifecycle readiness 的 DONE 准备条目会展示报告过期并提示重跑 done_prepare。

happy.desc: 文档要求记录并比较主分支基准值/merge 基准值

edge.desc: 文档覆盖 main 有新提交时 report 失效与重跑路径

adversarial.desc: 验证未在 done_prepare 描述里直接回归 headHash-only 造成误判的边界场景

verificationEvidence.note: Expanded done_prepare binding contract with local main tip capture and stale condition wording.

items.title: Align text flow, Mermaid, and SVG wording around handoff and rollback
items.context: Replace abstract Target proof complete wording with blocking/manual/external readiness wording, add no mutation in V1 to STOP, make Step 4 a handoff, and model rollback as a likely next action for host review rather than a downstream stage after STOP.
items.userSees: 文本流程、Mermaid 与 SVG 的 READY 判定与 rollback 文案与 handoff 同步，图例和 next action 风格一致。

happy.desc: 检查文档、Mermaid 与 SVG 在关键判定词与 STOP 行为上保持一致

edge.desc: 验证 rollback 在 V1 仅表现为主机可执行/非命令 next action 而非独立 stage

adversarial.desc: 验证是否出现与 step 4 handoff 重复或冲突的描述，导致实现歧义

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Target proof complete" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-lifecycle-readiness-check-execution-plan.md && rg -n "Handoff: print next lifecycle command only" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-lifecycle-readiness-check-execution-plan.md docs/requirements/decisions/assets/lattice-lifecycle-readiness-check-flow.svg && rg -n "Rollback" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-lifecycle-readiness-check-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: 对齐文本流程、Mermaid 与 SVG: 更新停点判定语义、STOP 无变更提示，并移除 rollback 作为独立 stage。
